picker.title: Photo
picker.checking: Checking whether photos can be added…
picker.blocked: Photos can't be added for this person. You can save the record without a photo.
picker.offline: No connection. Photos need internet: they are not stored on the phone. You can save the record without a photo.
picker.tooLarge: The photo is too large. Try another one.
picker.notImage: That file isn't a photo. Try another one.
picker.noPreview: This phone can't show the preview. It will be converted when sent.
picker.privacy: Location and camera data are removed. With consent, it is shared right away with the relatives who agreed to receive photos.
picker.needsInternet: The photo is sent when you save, with internet. It is not stored on the phone.

caregiver.savedWithPhoto: Activity saved with photo. The agency will review it before sharing it with the family.
caregiver.queuedPhotoDropped: No signal: the activity was saved and will be sent automatically. The photo was not saved because it needs internet.
caregiver.photoFailed: The activity was saved, but the photo wasn't. {{reason}}
caregiver.retryBody: The activity “{{title}}” was saved. The photo is only on this screen: it is lost if you leave.
caregiver.retryNotAllowed: The photo can no longer be added to this activity.
caregiver.photoSent: Photo sent. The agency will review it.
caregiver.savedShared: Activity saved. The photo was shared with the authorised family.
caregiver.savedAgencyOnly: Activity saved. The photo is for the agency only: there is no consent to share it.
caregiver.photoSentShared: Photo sent and shared with the authorised family.
caregiver.photoSentAgencyOnly: Photo sent. It is for the agency only.
caregiver.windowNote: You see your photos only during the visit (until 1 hour after it ends) and can remove them if you made a mistake.
caregiver.removeConfirm: Remove this photo? It is deleted for everyone, the family included, and cannot be recovered.
caregiver.removeFailed: The photo could not be removed. {{reason}}

errors.offline: No connection. The photo was not sent.
errors.consentRequired: This person has no current photo consent. The activity was saved without a photo.
errors.alreadyAttached: This activity already has a photo.
errors.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.badImage: That image couldn't be used. Try another photo.
errors.notAllowed: Photos aren't available for this record.
errors.withCode: The photo couldn't be sent. Code: {{code}}

review.title: Activity photos
review.description: History of the photos caregivers send. With consent, they are shared automatically with the relatives who agreed to receive them. You can withdraw or delete them; everything is recorded.
review.reasonHint: 3 to 300 characters. It stays in the history.
review.withdrawWarning: The family will stop seeing it immediately.
review.confirmShareBody: Authorized relatives of {{name}} will see it. You can withdraw it later.
review.withdrawn: Photo withdrawn. The family no longer sees it.
review.noShareConsent: No current consent to share with the family. Record it on the resident's profile before sharing.
review.showAgainBody: The authorised relatives of {{name}} will see it again, if the consents are still in force.
review.deleteWarning: It is deleted for everyone, the family included, and cannot be recovered: there is no copy.
review.agencyOnlyNote: There was no consent to share when it was sent: only the agency sees it.
review.holdNote: For an incident, complaint or request. Review within 90 days; at most 2 renewals and 270 days. It lapses unless renewed.
review.legalNote: Administrators only. For an obligation in force (official request, litigation, investigation). It never lapses and has no limit: the photo cannot be deleted until you release it. The family does not see it after the period.
review.legalOverdue: Review overdue: confirm the obligation is still in force. The photo is kept.

consents.title: Photo consent
consents.description: Without capture consent no photos can be taken; without sharing consent, the family sees none.

signer.PATIENT: Signed by the person receiving care

consents.formHint: PDF or photo of the form. Camera data is removed.
consents.recordNote: It can't be edited or deleted: to change it, revoke it and record a new one.
consents.revokeWarning: It takes effect immediately. Revoking sharing consent hides every photo from the family. Revoking capture consent stops new photos, and photos taken under it can't be shared.

agencyErrors.offline: No connection. Try again when the signal is back.
agencyErrors.statusChanged: Someone else already reviewed this photo. The list was updated.
agencyErrors.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
agencyErrors.consentRequired: It can't be shared: there is no current consent to share with the family, or the consent the photo was taken under was revoked.
agencyErrors.invalidTransition: That action is no longer possible for this photo.
agencyErrors.notAllowed: Only the agency's administration and supervisors can do this.
agencyErrors.notFound: Not found. It may no longer be available.
agencyErrors.consentAlreadyActive: There is already a current consent of that type. Revoke it before recording another.
agencyErrors.formInvalid: The form must be a PDF or a photo.
agencyErrors.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a few seconds.
agencyErrors.onHold: It is on hold: release the hold before deleting it.
agencyErrors.onLegalHold: It is under a legal hold: it cannot be deleted while it is in force.
agencyErrors.holdLimit: The exceptional hold limit was reached (3 actions or 270 days). If there is an obligation in force, use the legal hold.
agencyErrors.holdInvalid: Check the reason (at least 10 characters) and the review date (within 90 days).
agencyErrors.holdExists: The hold already changed. The list was refreshed.
agencyErrors.notShareable: This photo was not shared when sent; it cannot be shown to the family.
agencyErrors.legalAdminOnly: Only the agency's administrators manage legal holds.

family.noneToday: No photos shared today yet. When a caregiver sends a photo of an activity, it will appear here.
family.noneShift: No photos were shared from this shift.
family.gone: This photo is no longer available.

receipt.title: Activity photos
receipt.question: Do you want to receive photos of {{name}}'s activities?
receipt.body1: Caregivers may send photos of daily activities, such as meals or walks. You will only see them if you accept.
receipt.body2: You will only receive photos sent after you accept, not earlier ones.
receipt.body3: Each photo is available for a limited time and is then deleted. They cannot be downloaded from the app, but they could still be copied from the screen: handle them with care.
receipt.body4: You can change your mind at any time.
receipt.declinedNote: You do not receive photos of {{name}}.
receipt.failed: It could not be saved. Try again.

recipients.title: Relatives who receive photos
recipients.description: Each relative decides in their portal whether to receive photos. It starts at «No». The sharing consent is also needed.
recipients.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded.
